intro: Covers lessons 8 to 18 of Wudu and the adhan. Answer every question. For multiple choice, fill in one circle.

questions.q: What do we say when we hear 'hayya 'ala s-salah'?
options: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
questions.a: A) La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah. The Prophet ﷺ taught this reply (Muslim): we ask Allah for the strength to go.
A) To be pure for salah. Wudu is worship: Allah commands it before prayer (5:6).

options: Washing the feet to the ankles
questions.a: A) Washing the feet to the ankles. The feet are named in 5:6, so fard. Three times and the nose are sunnah.
A) Come to success. Falah is success; salah is prayer.
A) Rinsing the mouth. Mouth and nose are sunnah; face and feet are named in 5:6.
